View current shipment milestones: 'Order Placed', 'Shipped', 'In Transit', or 'Out for Delivery' [KB-26]. 4. Click the carrier tracking number (UPS, FedEx, or USPS) to view detailed geolocation scans on the carrier portal [KB-26]. 5. If checking out as a guest, visit acme-store.example.com/track and enter your order number and billing zip code [KB-26].

tickets.text: I need assistance seeing the restitution status
tickets.reply:
1. Sign in to your Acme Store account at acme-store.example.com [KB-27].
2. Navigate to 'Returns & Refunds' under your Account dashboard [KB-27].
3. Select your return claim using your return tracking number (e.g., #RET-77654) or original order number (#ACME-12345) [KB-27].
4. Review the return progress: 'Package in Transit to Warehouse', 'Return Inspected & Approved', or 'Refund Issued' [KB-27].
5. Once status shows 'Refund Issued', check your bank or credit card statement within 3 to 5 business days for the posted credit [KB-27].
